context: Hina-young tells Mei her future university application plans.
purpose: Teen confiding plans with adult mentor.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Mei — I've decided on my university!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Quick rush of excitement on the announcement. Warm and proud, like she's been holding this news and can finally share it. Light, youthful energy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Oh, what kind of place are you thinking?
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious. No interrogation — just real interest. Lean in slightly. Warm and encouraging without pushing. The tone of someone who wants to hear more.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Quieter, more thoughtful. Earnest and sincere — she's shared something real. Slight hesitation that says she's still weighing it, but conviction underneath. Soft trailing on the period.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Work hard on those exams, okay?
lines.style: Tender and steady. Gentle emphasis on the encouragement — not a demand, a wish. Warm undertone that says I believe in you. Slow, deliberate pace. Eye-contact steadiness.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I really want to make this dream come true.
lines.style: Determined but not aggressive. Soft-spoken conviction. The words carry weight because they're spoken quietly. Slight intensity building under the warmth — this matters to her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Steady, warm, and almost solemn in its sincerity. No performance — just simple steadfastness. Slow pace. The kind of promise that sits quietly but holds.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: That makes me feel so much stronger. Thank you!
lines.style: Bright relief and gratitude pouring through. Quick, light delivery on the thanks. Full-hearted without being loud. The warmth of being truly seen and supported.
